_comment: Every level pays (docs/ROADMAP.md 0.7.2, progression/levels.py). A level that opens a rune slot, a gear slot or the stall, or brings a level title, pays that; every other level from 2 to 50 pays one consumable, taking these in turn. Every tenth level adds a Rare sealed chest. Levels reached before 0.7.2 are paid on the first look at the inventory.
